It's alright!
Oct 2019 • Solo
I visited for the first time last Tuesday, the bar was almost empty so was served quickly.

The service was OK, the server was friendly and polite. Ask how long she had been working to which she said 2 months, which was a surprise as she didn't have very much product knowledge. 

The menu is just the same, it would be nice if they had some discription of the cheeses even basic info. 

Had 3 cheese plater, the duck rillette with some delicious bread and piccalilli. They have a good range of wine and a couple of local craft beers on tap. 

Over all not a bad experience, not sure how I'd be back though (well maybe just to try the croque monsieur, that did look good).

reviews.review_text:
Sakshi
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam110 contributions
0
Pay European prices for bad food and service
Aug 2019 • Friends
I wish I could give a zero rating instead of 1. There was nothing good about the place except ambience. We went for brunch, and for starters the waitress barely understood what we were asking for. My partner repeated his order of a simple grilled cheese sandwich at least 4 times to 2 different waitresses, and yet what we got was cold baguette with cheese. On yet again repeating that we wanted flat bread grilled cheese sandwich, they just took it back and grilled it in the microwave. That’s a lot of price to pay in Saigon for 10 bucks. I ordered an omelette with cheese which was served cold, with cold salad and no bread. We tried to explain to the waitress that they need to get better to which she only said that they are new and they have no staff. Not sure why the staff was required because the place was completely empty with 3 waiters. 

I live in Saigon and this was clearly one of the worst brunch experience I’ve ever had. Regret starting our Sunday with such a terrible experience.
Read more
Written August 4, 2019
Le Padam Saigon
Hello, 

First of all, we would like to say sorry for your bad experience at our place to you and your partner again. 

Once again, we would like to say that we do not have grilled cheese sandwich in the menu, so maybe, it could cause a misunderstanding with our staffs. Also, our staffs assured that they brought the omelette right after they finished making it so we really do not understand why the omelette was cold. And we keep the salad, the salad sauce in the fridge to keep it as fresh as we could to serve so again, we do not understand why you complaint about the cold salad. And to answer your other complain about the bread, we do not serve bread with omelette so that was why you did not have bread with omelette. But of course, if you would like to have bread with your omelette, we would bring it for you with no doubt.

We hope to see you and your partner again to have another experience and a better one.

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam4 contributions

Terrible place. Avoid at all costs.
Aug 2019 • Couples
Only thing "French" about this place is the price. I wanted a simple grilled cheese sandwich on flat bread. The staff did not understand what I was saying despite explaining this concept to them 4 times. What they did prepare was a baguette with cheese. I asked them to heat it up but instead of grilling it, they simply popped it in the microwave which basically destroyed both the bread the cheese. All of this after a 30 minute wait time. This terrible "sandwich" was 205,000 VND. 

I paid the full bill but complained to the lady at the counter. Her excuse was that the place was short staffed because the place had just opened. However, the place was dead with just one other patron.

Maybe this place is better for dinner but I am definitely not going back there again. Avoid at all costs. There are MUCH better places in Saigon.
Read more
Written August 4, 2019
Le Padam Saigon
Dear Sir,

We are very sorry about your bad experience at our place.

We do not have "grilled cheese sandwich" in our menu, that's why it could make our staff confused. Sorry about that. And we do not have microwave too. We have some customers who want their sandwich warm and ask us to heat the sandwich to melt the cheese for them. So we think, our staffs misunderstood your order. No matter what, it was our fault to messed up your orders, and we are really sorry once again for this mistake. 

Thank you so much for coming and leaving only bad reviews so we can improve more.
